fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on gambling and racing in Greater Miami (including discussion of the Miami Beach Beach and Tennis Club and enforcement of anti-gambling policies), coverage of racing at Tropical Park and related sports/nightlife columns, and a report on a police brutality case involving Officer G. A. Denny and the civil service board. Also noted are items on radio broadcasting business (WIOD), proposed federal housing for Black residents in Miami’s northwest section, and letters/opinion on national utility regulation (the Rayburn bill), alongside society/club notes and extensive local advertising.
